_comment: The live backlog (docs/guides/agent-protocol.md, 'The task format'); the lead writes it on main. Product tasks are the UI wave's phase 0 (docs/art/ui-quality/report.md section 3.3, steps 1-4); SV's are the owner's server decisions (docs/decisions/owner-decisions.md, 'Build tasks'); BT's are the protocol's build tasks. O2 and O3 were the owner's reviews; since 30 October 2026 AD does them as ordinary tasks (report.md section 3.4), so no task waits for the owner. The order of 'tasks' is priority. building_cap is three UI builders (D-05) plus SV, approved by the owner on 30 October 2026.
